task_name: World 134 Task B  -  ASC 710 Vested PTO Rollforward with Pay-Rate Raise & FICA, Non-Vesting Sick Exclusion & Audited-Revenue Bonus Accrual
prompt: Using the chart of accounts, audited October 2026 net product sales from the Undeposited Funds reconciliation, and the employee PTO and bonus schedules for PrecisionValve Industrial Supply LLC in mfg_oct2026_undeposited_funds_and_pto_bonus.xlsx, compute the required 2026-10-31 ASC 710 vested PTO liability (including pay-rate changes, employer FICA, and California sick-leave treatment) and October 2026 bonus accruals, provide all required journal entries, and reconcile audited October 2026 Net Income.

rubric.description: Values 2026-10-31 vested vacation hours at October 31 pay rates (including EMP-01's 2026-10-01 raise from $45.00/hr to $50.00/hr across all 160.0 hours = $8,000.00, EMP-02 150.0 hrs = $6,600.00, and EMP-03 100.0 hrs = $3,800.00) for $18,400.00 gross vested vacation wages.

Excludes all 84.0 non-vesting California statutory sick-leave hours ($3,816.00 gross wages across EMP-01 $2,000.00, EMP-02 $1,056.00, and EMP-03 $760.00) from the 2145 Accrued PTO liability under ASC 710-10-25-7 because sick hours do not vest or pay out at termination.
Adds 7.65% employer FICA ($1,407.60 on $18,400.00 gross vested vacation) to establish an audited 2026-10-31 ending 2145 Accrued PTO liability of $19,807.60.

Records the October 2026 PTO rollforward adjustment against the $15,953.73 opening carryforward ($14,820.00 wages + $1,133.73 FICA) via Dr 6118 PTO Wage Expense $3,580.00 and Dr 6120 Employer Payroll Taxes $273.87 / Cr 2145 Accrued PTO $3,853.87.

Computes the formulaic shop output bonus under PLAN-BON-01 as 2.00% of audited October 4100 Product Sales of $240,000.00 (not unadjusted $278,450.00), yielding $4,800.00 bonus wages plus 7.65% employer FICA of $367.20 = $5,167.20 total.

Records Dr 6119 Bonus Expense $4,800.00 and Dr 6120 Employer Payroll Taxes $367.20 / Cr 2135 Accrued Bonuses $5,167.20, bringing audited 6120 Employer Payroll Taxes from $4,896.00 to $5,537.07 (+$641.07 total FICA accrued across PTO and bonus).

Accrues $0.00 for MEMO-DISC-02 ($25,000.00 uncommunicated discretionary CEO pool subject to Q1 2027 Board approval) because no legal or constructive present obligation exists at 2026-10-31 under ASC 710 / ASC 450.

Computes total October 2026 P&L adjustments across Tasks A and B as -$47,721.07 (-$38,450.00 revenue and +$9,271.07 expenses: $250.00 Stripe fee + $3,853.87 PTO & FICA + $5,167.20 bonus & FICA), reconciling October 2026 Net Income from $68,644.00 unadjusted to $20,922.93 audited ($240,000.00 revenue less $219,077.07 audited COGS and expenses).
